description: Bushfire Protection Areas is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Housing and Urban Development. IMPORTANT NOTE: The Bushfire Protection Areas falls under the Development Act 1993 and has been superseded by the Bushfire Overlays (found in [Planning and Design Code Overlays][id]) under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Housing and Urban Development. Its tags are bushfires, land, nature, planning, safety. It offers 5 resource(s) in geojson, html, kml, map viewer, shp. The portal shows 2024-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
